verdict.rationale: Microsoft Copilot is itself an AI assistant/agent, with agentic features such as Browse with Copilot and Cowork, so it occupies the MCP client role. Publishing an official MCP server for other agents is a different product role. Its consumer connectors (OneDrive, Gmail, etc.) are client-side integrations, and nothing in the evidence shows Copilot running as an MCP server, so this axis does not apply.
